name: Market Context Agent
description: Provides macro regime analysis (yield curve, VIX, DXY, sector rotation) and competitive peer landscape positioning using CrewAI

skills.name: Macro Regime Analysis
skills.description: Assess current macro environment (yield curve regime, VIX volatility, DXY dollar strength, sector ETF rotation) and determine if it favours or penalises the target stock
examples: What is the macro environment for NVDA?
Does the current rate regime favour AAPL?

skills.name: Competitive Peer Landscape
skills.description: Compare target stock against sector peers on growth, margins, and valuation to identify relative positioning headwinds and tailwinds
examples: How does MSFT compare to its software peers?
Is TSLA expensive relative to auto sector peers?
